provenance.determinism: No sampling or randomized computation; seed reserved for adapter protocols

dependencies.scope: Direct adapter and active connector distributions only; transitive packages and native binaries require a worker image/dependency lock.

results.label: Binary classification performance
limitations: Performance is measured on supplied labels and predictions; independence, representativeness, temporal validity, and target leakage require review.

results.label: Probability calibration
limitations: Calibration uses 80 of 80 valid prediction rows; probability scores refer to positive label '1'.
ECE depends on fixed equal-width probability bins; sparse bins and prevalence shift require review.

results.label: Demographic parity difference

details.comparison: maximum minus minimum group selection rate

limitations: Descriptive group comparisons are not a causal finding of discrimination or a legal compliance verdict.
Metrics may conflict; protected-attribute collection requires an independently established lawful basis and access controls.
Intervals assume independent observations; clustered or repeated records require a different protocol.

results.label: Disparate impact ratio

details.comparison: minimum divided by maximum group selection rate

limitations: Descriptive group comparisons are not a causal finding of discrimination or a legal compliance verdict.
Metrics may conflict; protected-attribute collection requires an independently established lawful basis and access controls.
Intervals assume independent observations; clustered or repeated records require a different protocol.

results.label: Equalized odds difference

details.comparison: maximum of TPR range and FPR range

limitations: Descriptive group comparisons are not a causal finding of discrimination or a legal compliance verdict.
Metrics may conflict; protected-attribute collection requires an independently established lawful basis and access controls.
Intervals assume independent observations; clustered or repeated records require a different protocol.

results.label: Distribution drift: feature_age

details.smoothing: Jeffreys 0.5 pseudocount per bin; proportions renormalized

details.pValueMethod: two-sample asymptotic Kolmogorov approximation; not exact; ties/discrete data violate its continuous-distribution assumption
details.multiplicity: No multiplicity-corrected inference; each feature is a descriptive screening control.

limitations: Distribution change does not itself establish model degradation or regulatory noncompliance.
Missing values are excluded and missingness rates are separately recorded; review missingness change.
Reference selection, seasonality, dependence, multiple-feature testing, and feature scale require review.

results.label: SHAP explanation
limitations: Capability unavailable in this runner: A fitted-model adapter and its validated background dataset are required.

results.label: Cross-validation
limitations: Capability unavailable in this runner: A reviewed training procedure, fold plan, and leakage controls are required.

results.label: Record-keeping validation
limitations: Capability unavailable in this runner: Inference logs, retention rules, event schema, and source-system access are required. A diagnostic run log alone is insufficient.
This is a diagnostic evidence report. It does not determine legal compliance or replace an authorized auditor's judgment.
Local hashes and exclusive file creation support integrity; organizational immutability requires signed manifests, object-lock storage, retention controls, and authorized custody.
